newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN GOVT OFFICIALS TO DEVELOP FRIENDLY FACE.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN GOVT OFFICIALS TO DEVELOP FRIENDLY FACE.

text.p: The Belgian government on Friday announced a package of measures aimed at making government services more accessible, friendly and efficient.

"The federal administration is aware of the fact that relations between government workers and the public they serve is not ideal," Public Administration Minister Andre Flahaut told a news conference after a cabinet meeting that was entirely devoted to the public sector.

The government plans to cut out political influence in the recruitment of government workers, introduce permanent training and new evaluation methods for government workers, who will be fired if they do not perform.
"Before, you had to pretty much kill your father and mother before being thrown out of the public administration, we now will have a system for negative and positive sanctions," Flahaut said.
"A good democracy requires a good public service," he added.
